title: Whoever Loves Discipline Loves Knowledge

questions.question: But he who hates reproof is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:1 (ESV): "but he who hates reproof is stupid."

questions.question: A good wife is the crown of her husband, but she who brings shame is like what in his bones?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:4 (ESV): "but she who brings shame is like rottenness in his bones."

questions.question: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but a wise man listens to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:15 (ESV): "but a wise man listens to advice."

questions.question: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord, but those who act faithfully are his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:22 (ESV): "but those who act faithfully are his delight."

questions.question: A righteous man regards the life of his beast, but the mercy of the wicked is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:10 (ESV): "but the mercy of the wicked is cruel."

questions.question: Whoever works his land will have plenty of bread, but he who follows worthless pursuits lacks what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:11 (ESV): "but he who follows worthless pursuits lacks sense."

questions.question: There is one whose rash words are like sword thrusts, but the tongue of the wise brings what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:18 (ESV): "but the tongue of the wise brings healing."

questions.question: Anxiety in a man's heart weighs him down, but a good word makes him what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:25 (ESV): "but a good word makes him glad."

questions.question: In the path of righteousness is life, and in its pathway there is no what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:28 (ESV): "and in its pathway there is no death."

questions.question: A man is commended according to his good sense, but one of twisted mind is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:8 (ESV): "but one of twisted mind is despised."

questions.question: Better to be a nobody and yet have a servant than to pretend to be somebody and have no what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:9 (ESV): "than to pretend to be somebody and have no bread."

questions.question: The wicked is ensnared by the transgression of his lips, but the righteous escapes from what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:13 (ESV): "but the righteous escapes from trouble."

questions.question: The prudent man conceals knowledge, but the heart of fools proclaims what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:23 (ESV): "but the heart of fools proclaims folly."

questions.question: The slothful man does not roast his game, but the diligent man gets what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 12:27 (ESV): "but the diligent man gets precious wealth."

key_verse_text: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
